name: globals-workspace
description: Synchronous reads of shared application state across Electron processes.

scripts.verify: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.gate:chaos: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs packages/electron/test/chaos-app/main.mjs --report packages/electron/test/chaos-app/chaos-result.json --seconds 60
scripts.gate:example: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs examples/multi-window/main.mjs
scripts.gate:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs packages/electron/test/e2e-app/main.mjs --report packages/electron/test/e2e-app/e2e-result.json
scripts.gate:docker: docker build -f docker/gate.Dockerfile -t globals-gate . && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host globals-gate
